name: 80s gated drum room
desc: Hard gate on a crushed room mic or reverb: full ambience for a quarter second, then a sudden 40 ms cut

refs.why: heavily compressed room mic gated to cut the big ambience short
Padgham found the gated room sound on Gabriel's third album at Townhouse

notes: Put a heavy compressor before it on the room or reverb return. The effect is the abrupt all-to-nothing cut: hold sets the size, keep release short
